learn_source: Watch the farmer open a seed-row without a plough at the field edge of the Town scene — the festival week's planting happens between every other job
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on worked ground once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the furrow runs long, straight, and seed-deep; at baseline it is short and shallow and wants a second pass. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: tilled and soft, a clean furrow opens the cast's length; packed hard or frozen, only a scuffed line — the ground has to be worked first
Turns a narrow strip, grass-side down
No physical effect — the ground parts near it, the animal does not
receivers.reaction_kind: delighted digging at the fresh furrow
hums on, steps over the new furrow without comment
